title: Unit Event — Lead to Shine More

meta.Outline: With more work offers coming in for MORE MORE JUMP! than they can fulfill, Haruka and the others have a serious talk about their work priorities moving forward.

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone! I know that was a long stream!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... The MORE MORE Study Session got a way better reaction than I was expecting!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! At first, I was honestly pretty worried about us just doing homework and stuff for three hours...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it was really nice to see some viewers say that they'd also do their best, even though school isn't really their thing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm also glad they seemed to enjoy the games we played and conversations we had during our breaks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, Saito, that reminds me...
You said you wanted to talk to us about something after we'd finished?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, I was hoping to discuss your work schedules moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'm sure you all remember the last discussion we had regarding how you've been receiving an influx of offers...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: The truth is, we're receiving so many that we simply can't accept all of them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I've been doing my best to accept as many as possible, but your schedules are starting to reach their respective limits.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like to take this opportunity to discuss what sorts of offers you should be accepting as a group moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But that's really amazing!
I didn't realize we were getting so many offers.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, your successful appearance on “Chat A Lot About Nothing with Takashi Arimura!” has led to an increase in offers to appear on TV...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But the offers you've accepted since have also gone well, so I have to think that your group's name value within the industry has gone up quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's nice to know that the things we've done until now haven't gone unnoticed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, can you tell us what sorts of offers we've been receiving lately?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, I put together a list for you all to see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, what do we got...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
We have an offer from “Funtime Lunchtime”?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you familiar with that program, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's the variety show that's hosted by Wanchanko! The comedian who made huge waves during that manzai contest last year!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I think that's the show one of my friends was watching during lunch! I remember Wanchanko and the guests splitting into teams to play games and have a cooking battle...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's the one. It's only available for viewing online, but it's apparently become a huge hit amongst younger viewers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're also being asked to model for magazines, give food reviews, appear for radio... Oh, here's an offer about a documentary surrounding a town revitalization project.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A town revitalization project?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it seems they help out at local events and festivals.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that means we could make everyone watching and the people in the town smile...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, these offers all sound wonderful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But this is also where we have to make our selection...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. And that's why we're having this discussion. To figure out some criteria regarding which to accept.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Criteria...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no right or wrong answer, you know? And every group goes about this differently...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For example, if a group wants to really get their name out there no matter what, then they'll choose programs with good ratings.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But if a group wants to keep to a certain theme or image, then they might pick and choose based on that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our dream is to become idols who can spread hope to everyone across Japan, and do a show at the Dome...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I feel that we should develop a protocol that's going to help us make that dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin by tossing around some ideas. Who'd like to start us off?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, can I go first...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, the floor is yours!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe that spreading hope to others needs to continue taking absolute priority above all else.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because that's what matters most to us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree completely.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. After all, that's what we've set out to do as idols.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, whether or not we're able to spread hope to others through these offers comes entirely down to us... But we can still choose the ones that suit us the best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For instance, we can pick programs that are designed to move, encourage or make their viewers smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Alright, it sounds like we're all in agreement in terms of spreading hope to others being our main criterion!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That said, getting our name out in front of a lot of people is still pretty important.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I mean, the Dome seats 30,000.
We made a show at the Butokan an intermediate goal, but even that seats 15,000.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If we are going to make our dream a reality, then we're gonna need to increase our name recognition to the point of being able to fill those places at the very least.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, then... We should be accepting offers that allow us to spread hope to others, while increasing our media exposure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's where we are as things stand.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm sure there's more we haven't thought of yet, so let's keep throwing around ideas.
One hour later
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Alright, let's summarize what we've come up with so far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, we've got spreading hope to others and increasing our media exposure.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We also have, umm...
Whether or not we can appear as a group! That's really important!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. A lot of people will be hearing about MORE MORE JUMP! for the very first time, so we'll want their first impression of us to be that we're a proper idol group.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then there was the matter of leaving enough time for us to keep doing streams.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We've already had to reduce the number we do, so I fear that our fans are going to feel just that much more disappointed if we go any further...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, spreading hope to others through our streams has always been a big deal to us, so we should keep trying to do as many as we can.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: What else is there...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I think we've covered just about everything...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But are there any offers that actually cover all those points?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I doubt there are going to be any that cover all of them, so we might want to order them by importance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: With spreading hope to others for sure taking the top spot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Followed by increasing our media exposure. Doing those two things will be the quickest way for us to realize our dream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree with that order.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Understood.
Then, I'll place those two things at the forefront, while also taking the other criteria we've come up with into consideration...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry, but...
Would it be alright if I gave this some more thought?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree with what you said in terms of those two things taking top priority, Airi. I don't see anything wrong with that ordering.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like we're still missing something.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We are?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm not sure how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But when I ask myself if choosing work like this will really lead to us making our dream come true, I feel like we're still missing some key piece...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A key piece...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry. I know what I'm saying is really vague...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I know I have a habit of overthinking things in these sorts of situations.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
Your attentiveness has saved our skins a bunch of times already!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's right. If there's something on your mind, Haruka, then I'd also like to think about it with you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, let's take our time and try to come up with a solution that we can all agree on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure we'll be able to figure out what we're missing if we all put our heads together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That being said, we shouldn't keep these people waiting too long. We'll need to set ourselves a deadline, and then decide which offers to accept...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, let's give ourselves until tomorrow.
I promise to have my answer by then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
We'll also take another hard look at things!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
For now, let's adjourn this meeting...
You all have that magazine interview scheduled, so let's start getting ready to head over!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! It's already that late?!
L-Lemme go get my notebook! It has all my answers to their questions in it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, didn't you just put it back in your bag?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez, relax, will you?
A few hours later
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I still can't figure it out...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: With spreading hope to others for sure taking the top spot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Followed by increasing our media exposure. Doing those two things will be the quickest way for us to realize our dream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I still don't think what Airi said is wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is it really okay for us to make decisions based on just these criteria?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Will we be able to stand there? Will our fans be able to come see us...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (On that stage...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, what criteria did we use as ASRUN when it came to work?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Mr. Hiiragi always...)
A few years earlier
Rehearsal Area

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... We're moving much more in sync now.

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line: Yeah, we've totally got this formation down!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's start putting polish on the dance itself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Is everything okay?
You don't look too good. Are you not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member A
rows.Line: Oh, no... It's not that...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member A
rows.Line: The thing is... I just overheard our manager talking on the phone and...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line: Oh, what did you hear?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member A
rows.Line: You know the show “Go Wild & Crazy!”...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that daytime show that's run practically forever?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line:
Just once, I wanna go on!
I mean, there's no one in Japan who hasn't heard of it!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member A
rows.Line: ASRUN was asked to start appearing as regulars, but Mr. Hiiragi turned them down.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (He turned down an offer like that...?!)

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line:
Wh-Why...?!
People all over Japan watch “Go Wild & Crazy!”

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line:
Right?
Appearing as regulars would give us a huge boost in terms of name recognition...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line: It'd be a chance for us to start spreading hope to people all across Japan like the other top idol groups...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Would you mind stopping by the office after you're finished with practice, Haruka? Mr. Hiiragi would like a word with you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, understood.
Office
Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello, Mr. Hiiragi.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Hello. Sorry, I know this is sudden, but I received an offer asking for you and you alone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just me?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That's right. You're being asked to participate in a performance battle, where you and a few other idols will compete to see who can come up with the best dance routine on the spot.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: This is a chance to showcase not just yourself, but the technical prowess of ASRUN as a whole. Keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...!
Right!

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I'll send the details over to your manager.
That's all from me.
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
...?
What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's a question I'd like to ask.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is it true that you turned down an offer involving us becoming regulars on “Go Wild & Crazy!”?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Honestly...
I'll need to remind your manager not to take calls where people can hear him.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: W-Wait, so...!

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: It's all true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I asked why?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're trying to become idols who can spread hope to people all across Japan. I can't figure out any reason to...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That very dream is why I turned them down.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Why has ASRUN been able to become as popular as it has?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Because it's never lost sight of what makes it special.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What makes us special...?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Yes. I believe that idols need to feel unique in some way.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: In other words, ASRUN must offer something that other idols or artists can't hope to emulate. That's what sets your group apart from them.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Your fans will be drawn to that, and they'll be willing to cheer at the top of their lungs for you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Cheer...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Yes, in support of your dream.
To make it come true together.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: They're absolutely crucial.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hearing our fans cheer us on and feel encouraged by what we do has been huge in terms of us getting this far...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Some have even reached out to their friends and family and invited them to cheer us on together...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We started out selling CDs by hand at shopping malls, and now look how far we've come.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Their voices, their support...
They kept driving ASRUN forward.)

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Yes, it's important to use high-profile programs to increase your name recognition.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: But establishing a loyal fan base takes absolute priority. Finding those who will cheer at the top of their lungs for you is beyond important.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the top of their lungs...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: What do you think it is that makes ASRUN special, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(What makes us special...
What separates us from everyone else in our fans' minds?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our performances?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Correct.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Your brilliant smiles, your compelling dances, the way your voices ring out towards the back... They inspire hope in everyone watching.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That's the kind of idol group ASRUN is.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That being said, I didn't make my decision regarding “Go Wild & Crazy!” lightly. I just felt that now wasn't the right time yet.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: People need to understand what ASRUN is actually about. Until that image is solidified in the public eye...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I want to place what makes ASRUN special at the forefront, even if it means we do things small for a while.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Because I believe that's the quickest way for your group to realize its dream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (All I'd been thinking about until now was “spreading hope to lots of people.”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I never thought about the best way to actually reach that goal.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Mr. Hiiragi's looking that far ahead...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I really appreciate you telling me all this.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
More importantly, I have high expectations for your next show.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Go show everyone what makes ASRUN special. That's going to be your ticket to the future.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Show everyone what makes us special...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right... He always accepted offers that would place what made ASRUN special at the forefront.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's what we've been missing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What is it that makes MORE MORE JUMP! special?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've been doing our best to put on good performances, but we can't really match the groups that have professional choreographers and trainers working with them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As for our talking skills... There's Airi, of course, and Minori also has a natural talent for making others smile and laugh. Still, I'm not sure that's what makes us special.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know there's something there. I just can't quite put it into words.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This is really frustrating...
How do I find the right words for what I'm feeling?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to ask the others about this, but it's already pretty late. I should probably wait until tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'll try popping over for a little bit to ask them.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope someone's here...
ーーーー♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: One, two, three... And pose!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. How was that? Good?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that felt pretty solid.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Then, let's do it just like that for the show...
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: KAITO, Len.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good evening. Sorry to catch you two so late.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to see you two practicing at this time. And your hard work seems to be paying off.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm so excited about my next show that I've been having Len help me like this as I practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is it going to be special in some way?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, to KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You know how he's been helping us come up with ideas for our shows and taking care of everything behind the scenes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, as a small token of our appreciation, we're handling everything for his next show as the producers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It certainly sounds like it's going to be a very special occasion for you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It is. Also, since Len and the others are going to all this trouble for me, I need to do my best too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, I do those things because I want to. It feels kind of strange to be thanked for that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
They're my friends, but I'm also their fan.
So, if anything, I should be the one thanking them for giving me the opportunity to help them show the audience just how wonderful they are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um, KAITO?
Like we're always saying, we feel the same way for you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I know!
Which is why...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm going to take all your kindness and put on the best show that I possibly can!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Break a leg.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, Haruka, what brings you here this late?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, the thing is, there's something I was hoping to ask you two.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What is it that makes MORE MORE JUMP! special...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. I remembered something that the producer for ASRUN said when I was still with them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I realized that showing everybody what makes us special should play a key role in terms of which offers for work we accept.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm having trouble finding the right words to describe what actually makes us special. I came here to get your objective opinions...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You girls are all wonderful, and you have many special things to offer...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I think MORE MORE JUMP! is so appealing because you're all able to just be yourselves in front of your fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Be ourselves...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. People tend to be drawn to idols because they have such a dazzling charm to them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But there's more than just that to you and the others, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're all doing your absolute best to spread hope to others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And when you were faced with a seemingly insurmountable challenge, you found a way to overcome it with the help of your fans.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we have a venue and date set, but we're still shorthanded in terms of staff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If our current situation holds, we'll have to limit the number of people that can attend our event or possibly cancel it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we want as many people to come to our event as possible. We want you all to be there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You showed your fans things that you normally wouldn't.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
That wasn't exactly our finest moment, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I believe that's what makes you girls special.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's what makes MORE MORE JUMP! so appealing to your fans. They get to see you as you all are, and feel close to you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have to think that seeing you all try your best inspires them to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To do the same...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it was really nice to see some viewers say that they'd also do their best, even though school isn't really their thing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, some of our viewers posted similar comments during our stream.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. One person said, “I feel so at home with you girls.” A couple even said, “I feel a lot more motivated seeing you do your best,” and, “Working with you four makes me feel like I can actually do it”...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So... Just being ourselves, and having all these close interactions with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Those are the reasons why we're able to spread hope to others as idols.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's what makes MORE MORE JUMP! special.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you both very much, Len, KAITO...

We couldn't possibly ask you to go that far...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's okay! We're the ones who suggested that we pass out bookmarks in the first place!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please let us do this.
We want to put smiles on the faces of everyone in this town and all those who participate in the marathon.

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Member
rows.Line: Girls...

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Member
rows.Line:
Then, please do.
I'd love to help out, but we still have things to do for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. You can leave this to us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's start by checking how many extra flowers we have. If we need more...

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: I can ask the flower shop to see if they have the ones we're using. I'll do something about the budget.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
In that case, we should be able to dry them out in time by using the microwave.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, Airi, Shizuku, could you two check our reserves and go with the chairman to get the flowers we need?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, can you gather up all the tools so we can get started right away? I'll bring the materials.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'll help you carry everything!

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line:
...
Keep the cameras rolling.

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: O-Of course!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that makes about twenty total.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, that's a lot already!
Though, we still have a long way to go until 400.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, that means we gotta really get cracking!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but we should also make each one with care.
Oh, you're really going at it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Members
rows.Line: Honestly, why didn't you come tell us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Everyone!
But what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: We should be asking you that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line:
Are they sure about this?
I mean, they're idols, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We apologize for doing this without consulting you all, but...

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: If the chairman hadn't told us, then you would've ended up doing all the work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line: Ah, don't look at us like that.

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line:
I understand why you'd be hesitant.
We didn't exactly welcome you with open arms.

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line: We thought you and that television crew were really just here for some feel-good footage.

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line: But when we actually bothered looking...

rows.Speaker: Local B
rows.Line: You've all worked so hard for our town.

rows.Speaker: Local B
rows.Line: Even when the cameras weren't on, you got muddy harvesting crops and you built that big stage. I honestly couldn't believe my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Local B
rows.Line: But it made us really happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line:
Besides, this is our town.
That means it's our duty to act.

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: Right. What we mean to say is...

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: Let's do this, together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's so great to hear.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's normal for them to be wary of outsiders and those they think they can't rely on. Their town is just that precious to them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, it's up to us to be the best diplomats we can, to help ease their worries.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have to take this marathon and our interactions with the locals very seriously. We need to show them that we're going to do our absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Our feelings made it through to them.)

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Members
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, your flowers are lined up so nicely. Can you show me how to do that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
You see, even if the flowers stick out a little at first, they'll shrink into position like this.

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Members
rows.Line: Oh, so that's the trick!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, you don't necessarily have to line them up in a row. You can actually layer them together too...
One month later
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: <Next, we have the segment you've all been waiting for. “The Town Revitalization Team!”>

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: <This week, we have MORE MORE JUMP! giving the town of Hanamioka a big hand.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, your segment's about to start!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Th-The stage needs so many planks of wood! We're never gonna finish carrying these over!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Normally, I'd tell you to quit complaining and keep working, but having to make round trips on this mountainous road is pretty draining.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <But this seems like the perfect time for a...! Happy Heave-Hooo!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<W-Wait...!
That's the technique that allows someone to use their full strength despite being really exhausted! Only truly happy idols can use that!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Every time I've used it, I've been able to get through a shoot no problem! So, let's get back to carrying these planks!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Okay, I'll do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line:
<Besides, this is our town.
That means it's our duty to act.>

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: <Right. What we mean to say is...>

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: <Let's do this, together.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<...!
Thank you very much.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Congratulations on finishing!
If you like, please take this commemorative bookmark.>

rows.Speaker: Runners
rows.Line: <Wow, this is so cute! It's like a little flower field!>

rows.Speaker: Runners
rows.Line: <Hehe. It's just like what we saw while we were running.>

rows.Speaker: Runners
rows.Line: <And the food was so good. We've gotta visit again sometime.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<...!
Thank you for saying that!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Th-That was so good...!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, it was! And I was so moved when the locals came to help you girls.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Me too. The way your earnestness reached them, and they came to help you out... It was so exciting to see!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, how did everyone watching react?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, about that... We didn't see that big a response online, since the program's viewership tends to be older...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we received a ton of fan mail.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: As in, letters?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, on top of those who made posts online, there were many who went out of their way to send you their thoughts on paper?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. They said things like, “I was encouraged by the way you worked so hard for them,” or “I wanted to show my support,” which made us really happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The program's ratings aren't actually all that high, but we feel that we spread hope to those who did watch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I think we deserve a pat on the back, considering how happy all the locals were.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: E-Everyone, I have big news!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Big news, Saito?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: The director for “The Town Revitalization Team!” just asked me about all of you...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Apparently, they're putting another show into development, and they want you on as regulars!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-In other words...
Another show's in development?
And they want us as regulars?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's not other words at all!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: It is a late-night slot, but it's for a big network!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?! A big network?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's incredible news, but why?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
So, it wasn't just us being contacted.
People have apparently been sending in an abnormally high volume of messages to the show!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: They want more of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And it's not just that. The director also said they'd personally love to work with you again.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I quote, “Getting the footage we wanted was obviously important, but considering how happy you made all the locals, we couldn't have asked for a better shoot.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's so wonderful to hear such high praise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! That means we managed to live up to the director's expectations!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we have you to thank, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. You took the time to make sure we'd choose an offer that would be perfect for our dream...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even while we were shooting, you placed the locals first and made all the right decisions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You made it a show that everyone, from the staff to the viewers, really enjoyed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can't thank you enough, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All your effort has allowed us to take another big step forward as a group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I just tried to do what I could, but I'm really glad you're all saying this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
By the way, Haruka.
I have a little idea...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How would you feel about becoming the producer for MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You mean...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, I'm not saying that you'll have to do everything. We'll still discuss anything that's really important as a group.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But with everything that happened this time around, it got me thinking. We'll have to be careful about how we keep on moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We need a producer to find that way for us, and keep pulling us in the right direction.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you're the only person who can do that, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You were the lead for an A-list idol group, which means there are certain things that only you can see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(The producer of MORE MORE JUMP!
That's a big responsibility...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If I take on that role, then my decisions will have a direct impact on our group's future...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd also like to ask you to do this, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only are you experienced and knowledgeable, you're perceptive and careful. Your calls have saved us so many times.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right.
I'd be more than happy to follow you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If you do accept, we promise to come up with ideas for streams and practice in your place... And we'll always be ready to help if you're in trouble!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They really believe in me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Then, I don't want to let them down. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You will?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. The truth is, I was also starting to feel that we need a dedicated producer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I couldn't be happier that my idea ended up helping MORE MORE JUMP! this much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now I want to keep coming up with ideas that will help us shine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to reach even greater heights with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I don't honestly know how good a producer I'll be as I am now... I'll have to start learning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you'll do great, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll probably be asking you a lot of questions moving forward too, Saito. So, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'll learn everything I can, and support you in every way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I have to really do my best here.
In order to make sure MORE MORE JUMP! shines brighter and brighter.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So that we become top idols who are able to spread hope to everyone in Japan.)
Talent Agency

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Hello, Mr. Hiiragi.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Ah, hello.
Quick question. You said something about “What's the Buzz?” looking at our idols for their list of up-and-comers...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: What's going on with that?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: A-About that... I checked with them, and they decided to give that spot to another group...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I see.
I was really hoping to lock that down.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
It sounded like they were really eager to get MORE MORE JUMP! in, given how popular they're getting.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP!, huh?
